verdict: News Corp grew revenue 6% to $2.3B in its fiscal first quarter, and total net income rose 43% to $215M as Dow Jones, digital real estate and books all grew.

segments.name: Dow Jones
segments.note: The Wall Street Journal, Barron's and professional information — up 8%, led by circulation, licensing, Risk & Compliance (+11%) and Energy (+8%).

segments.name: Digital Real Estate Services
segments.note: REA Group in Australia and Move (Realtor.com) — up 10%; REA rose 13% and Move 5%.

segments.name: Book Publishing
segments.note: HarperCollins books — up 9% on stronger physical and digital sales.

segments.name: News Media
segments.note: News UK, News Australia and the New York Post — down 1% as print advertising fell.

opex.name: Sales, general & administrative
opex.note: People and running costs across news, books and real-estate businesses.

opex.name: Impairment & restructuring
opex.note: Impairment and restructuring charges — a flagged one-time item.

otherDetail: Other is $38M of Other, net (including a gain on the divestiture of REA India's remaining business) plus $4M of net interest income. Equity losses of affiliates were $3M. Total net income was $215M; $159M was attributable to News Corp stockholders after $56M for noncontrolling interests.
footerNote: News Corp reports two share classes (NWS Class B and NWSA Class A) on one set of financial statements — this page uses the same consolidated figures for both tickers. The Other segment had $0 revenue this quarter, so segments show the four revenue-producing segments. Operating profit here is gross profit (revenue less operating expenses) less SG&A, depreciation and impairment/restructuring, before equity losses, interest and Other, net.
oneTimers: Other, net of $38M included a gain related to the divestiture of REA India's remaining business.
follow100Note: Kept as profit is total net income of $215M; $159M was attributable to News Corp stockholders.

takeaways.title: Three engines grew
takeaways.text: Dow Jones rose 8%, Digital Real Estate 10% and Book Publishing 9% — only News Media fell, down 1%.

takeaways.title: Segment EBITDA up 19%
takeaways.text: Total Segment EBITDA — the company's segment profit measure — rose to $403M from $340M.

takeaways.title: Net income jumped
takeaways.text: Total net income rose 43% to $215M, helped by higher segment profit and the REA India divestiture gain in Other, net.
